jobs.title: Cosmetology Master Instructor - Foundations
jobs.description: Cosmetology Master Instructor - FoundationsClary Sage College - Tulsa, OK 74145OverviewPosition TypeFull TimeEducation LevelHigh SchoolCategoryEducationDescriptionMinimum Requirements: Current Oklahoma Cosmetology Master Educator License, dual licensure as both a Cosmetology and Barber Instructor preferred, a minimum of three years of verified industry experience. The schedule for this position is: Monday - Thursday, Evenings 12:00 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. Duties & Responsibilities This instructor will lead students through the Milady Foundations curriculum with a focus on scientific concepts, theory understanding, and essential business skills. Teaching Responsibilities: Teach the Milady Foundations curriculum, including theory, scientific principles, safety and sanitation, professionalism, and introductory business concepts. Counsel students in a professional manner, offering encouraging, constructive, and timely feedback. Adhere to curriculum expectations to ensure accreditation standards are met. Proactively identify and address issues with course content, materials, or classroom technology. Send welcome emails to students on your roster two days before the scheduled start of class. Respond to written assignments with personalized comments and support. Model the CARES philosophy and core values through courage, teamwork, perseverance, and vision. Provide clear instruction on scientific concepts such as anatomy, chemistry fundamentals, electricity, infection control, and product knowledge. Teach foundational business skills including communication, customer service, goal planning, retail basics, professionalism, and workplace readiness. Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and foundational theory updates. Assist students with basic study skills, note taking, comprehension strategies, and academic success habits. Perform instructional assistance and tutoring as needed to support student understanding. Adhere to OSHA standards and maintain compliance in theory classrooms. Encourage students to stay positive, professional, and motivated as they enter the beauty industry. Maintain accurate documentation of grades and attendance and enter records in Canvas. Prepare students for future state board requirements by building strong theory comprehension and milestone competency. Keep classroom areas organized, sanitized, and stocked with learning materials. Order classroom supplies as needed and assist with inventory. Be familiar with Oklahoma State Board rules and other accrediting requirements that relate to foundational education. Support student retention by monitoring attendance, reviewing completion of learning activities, and contacting students as needed. Maintain a high performance environment that supports structure, accountability, and student success. Effort and Commitment Displays a high level of effort and commitment to all responsibilities. Operates effectively within the organizational structure and demonstrates responsible behavior. Shows eagerness to learn and accepts growing responsibilities. Displays a positive approach to work and persists through challenges. Works resourcefully within system expectations and adapts to new procedures. Accepts feedback from supervisors and follows through appropriately. Works scheduled hours, arrives on time, follows attendance procedures, and uses work time appropriately. Other Attend all graduation ceremonies Participate in school sponsored activities Complete a minimum of two professional developments and two in-service meetings annually. QualificationsQualifications: Foundations Instructors should have a natural talent for teaching, strong communication skills, and patience. They must be able to break down scientific concepts in a clear and supportive way while making theory engaging and relevant. jobs.description: Occupations Master Instructor Entry Level Salary Range $15.00 - $30.00 per hour Licensure/Certification Master Instructor License from the State Board of Cosmetology Resources Milady Master Educator S/P2 Safety Local Program Practicing Master Instructor CoursesHoursOCASOrientation6 Introduction to Teaching and Curriculum6 Course Development, Lesson Planning, and Teaching Practices132 Cosmetology Law, School Management, and Record Keeping42 Teaching and Assisting in the Classroom and Clinic42 Practice Teaching in the Classroom and Clinic72 Total Hours300 Suggested Entry Level Skills 10th grade reading level Basic math skills Algebra Clothing Requirement Uniforms are required; the cost is typically between $50 to $60 for top and pants and $20 for shoes. Other Information This is a 1000 hour course with the Oklahoma State Board of Cosmetology. Practicing Master Instructor students must show proof of two years of recent work as a cosmetologist to waive 700 hours and only complete 300 hours of coursework with CV Tech. DETAILS The Cosmetology program at CV Tech prepares students enrolled in the cosmetologist program for the State Board of Cosmetology licensing exam and to work in the cosmetology industry. Students will receive classroom instruction and hands-on training in sanitation, hair, scalp, nail, and facial treatments. Students must complete 1500 hours of training; high school students may have 500 hours waived if high school courses are successfully completed. Students must register with the State Board of Cosmetology, which requires a $5.00 fee and documentation of date of birth (must be 16 years old by November 1st) and social security number prior to attending class.High school students may not be enrolled in a pull-out academic class.
